title: process_update maps storage errors to SetErrorType::NotFound
description: submission.rs:582,604 — get_objects backend error and BackendSetError::Other both map to SetError::new(SetErrorType::NotFound). A database/storage failure is not 'not found'; it will mislead callers into thinking the object doesn't exist. Should propagate as serverFail at the method level (change process_update return type to Result<(), Value>) or via early return to JmapError.
